raw.meaning: 未经处理的原始摄入物；不是 wiki 事实

staging.meaning: 待整理的候选条目；不是 wiki 事实

curated.meaning: 经批准的精华条目；唯一的 wiki 事实层

index.rebuildSemantics: 索引可随时从 wiki/ 源记录重建；重建不得删除或改写源记录，也不得改变任何条目的知识授权状态；备份以源工件为准，不能只备份索引/向量
index.nativeReadback: read-only native documents/content + document_chunks + chunks_fts for the same MCP-created relative_path/version; no self-built table or replacement file is current proof

knowledgeAuthority.separation: The registered wiki workspace contains raw/, staging/, and wiki/curated/ only as knowledge tiers. Formal OpenSpec/source/native Comet state remain outside that workspace; index rows and labels never approve specs or issue grants.

knowledgeWrite.indexConsistencyGate: I04 emits storage/index facts only. A missing/stale native row is INCONSISTENT and cannot close Kp; the original Comet gate and independent verifier own the judgment.

observedEnforcement.serverContainment: VERIFIED-LOCAL-RUNTIME (in-process probe, disposable tmp workspace): vaultfs _resolve_path resolve()+is_relative_to containment denied a dir_path carrying ../.. and denied writing through an in-workspace symlink to an outside file (outside file unchanged); contained positive write allowed. Nuance: a filename component carrying '..' is not rejected and resolves still INSIDE the workspace — no cross-workspace escape, but the file can land in a different directory within the workspace (source: mcp/vaultfs/sqlite.py write_to_disk/_resolve_path)
observedEnforcement.versionMechanism: VERIFIED-LOCAL-RUNTIME: documents.version is set to 1 by create_document and incremented (COALESCE(version,0)+1) by every update_document; md/txt content is re-chunked into document_chunks and re-indexed into chunks_fts on every update (source: mcp/vaultfs/sqlite.py, mcp/services/chunker.py)
observedEnforcement.duplicateRejection: VERIFIED-LOCAL-RUNTIME: documents UNIQUE(relative_path) turns a duplicate create into DuplicateDocumentError; the create tool surfaces an already-exists error unless overwrite=true (source: shared/sqlite_schema.sql, mcp/tools/write.py)
observedEnforcement.schemaRejection: VERIFIED-LOCAL-STATIC: create rejects a missing title and missing tags with explicit error strings; edit requires a unique old_text match; delete refuses '*'/'**' and protects /wiki/overview.md and /wiki/log.md; tool argument types are enforced at the MCP protocol layer by the typed FastMCP tool signatures (source: mcp/tools/write.py, mcp/tools/delete.py)
observedEnforcement.writePathSingleChannel: the server writes file and index in one operation (write_to_disk + create/update_document); direct fs writes that bypass the MCP are invisible to the server-side guard and rely on the control-plane hook — see the controlPlaneHookGap risk
observedEnforcement.controlPlaneHookGap: hooks.yaml kb-write-protection does not currently cover the canonical landing path (see package.lock.json revisions[] risks); recorded for the control-plane owner, not fixed here
observedEnforcement.scope: facts only; Kp / index-consistency judgment remains with the original Comet gate and the independent verifier

approvedCuratedSourceTypes: project wiki pages with source and revision
intake.redaction: 摄入前必须脱敏：宿主绝对路径与秘密值一律剔除；来源读取凭据只经 secret-ref 引用解析

retention.curatedSourcesBackedUp: required — 精华源工件/来源与版本必须备份；索引可重建但恢复时须校验摘要与权限过滤
retention.r10UnfinishedRuns: 未完成 Run 引用的 wiki staging 与唯一批准 payload 不得因索引重建或 worktree 回收丢失
